status: Executable comparison specification and elementary identification limits; not a new method/theorem or training authorization
endpoint: Complete editable indoor scene generated from its original request; not single-asset export, repaired coordinates, tool return, teacher action match or rationale text quality

notation.X: Actual current multimodal scene, original requirements, same available observations and executed receipts
notation.D: Proposed public decision record, sampled from X, not a verified tool fact
notation.C: Mandatory task requirements evaluated on the final actual scene
notation.LD: The10 source units with original decision annotations;14 others retain only A

implemented_training_control.auxiliary: L_aux = sum_i l_A(X_i,A_i; original w_Ai) + sum_{i in LD} l_D(X_i,D_i; original w_Di)
implemented_training_control.conditioned: L_cond = sum_{i in LD} l_A(X_i,D_i,A_i; original w_Ai) + sum_{i not in LD} l_A(X_i,A_i; original w_Ai) + sum_{i in LD} l_D(X_i,D_i; original w_Di)
implemented_training_control.requirements: Same original labels/token coefficients, images, model initialization and family allocation. Do not fabricate missing D or delete missing-D actions. Prefix lengths differ, so report compute; full Trainer accumulation not established by the local CE oracle.
implemented_training_control.deployment: Direct A(X) versus D_hat~p(D|X), A~p(A|X,D_hat); all next observations come from each arm own executed state. No reference-D injection or saved downstream action replay.
implemented_training_control.current_material: 24 development units,19 original-observation encodings,5missing; not an independent generation test set.

theory.name: No extra environmental information
theory.assumptions: Condition on fixed learned parameters; D uses only X and independent sampling randomness, no extra observations.
theory.result: I(Y;D|X,theta)=0. This is conditional independence, not a prohibition of finite-compute policy improvement.
theory.not_identified: No guarantee of improved 3D decision quality, faithfulness or human preference.

theory.name: Teacher versus predicted decisions
theory.assumptions: Fixed X and same downstream action/tool policy; success probability v_X(d) lies in[0,1].
theory.proof: For f in[0,1], the maximal expectation difference over f equals TV; apply to v_X.
theory.not_identified: A single recorded reference D does not identify q, TV or an empirical task-success bound. Teacher-conditioned action likelihood is not deployment success.

theory.name: Valid actions are a set
theory.result: For valid-action set V(X), success probability is sum_{a in V(X)}p(a|X), not merely p(A_reference|X).
theory.limit: Tool strings serialize continuous geometry, equivalent poses and multiple acceptable organizations. Exact-answer likelihood and majority voting over strings do not define full-scene utility.

theory.name: Latent objective already has precedent
theory.result: For m_theta(A|X)=sum_D p_theta(D|X)p_theta(A|X,D), gradient log m = E_{posterior D|X,A}[grad log p_theta(D|X)+grad log p_theta(A|X,D)].
theory.scope: Standard differentiation of a mixture, assuming derivative/sum interchange and support; not a proposed new algorithm. LaTRO uses an expected-log-likelihood/KL surrogate, which is not the same as log marginal likelihood.
theory.limit: Dropping either derivative changes the objective; finite self-normalized importance gradients are generally biased. No latent objective was trained here.

theory.name: Frequency is not voting distribution
theory.result: Empirical action frequencies converge to the marginal distribution under iid sampling; the majority winner converges to its mode when unique. They are different objects.
theory.example: With two outputs of probabilities.6/.4, limiting frequencies are.6/.4, while the majority winner is the first with probability approaching1.
theory.scope: Elementary clarification needed when translating text self-consistency to many valid 3D tool actions, not a new critique experiment.

theory.name: Complete-scene and asset coverage
theory.result: If S is completion of all mandatory requirements and B is availability of all necessary assets/operations, S is a subset of B, hence P(S)<=P(B).
theory.scope: A single actual SDF import is evidence about one asset, not all-stage coverage. Unknown checks stay unknown; no conversion from a mean score into universal conjunction success.

strong_controls: Frozen public base with same complete task and ordinary multi-operation search
Same-source auxiliary D training, direct A at deployment
Direct A allowed to spend saved reasoning compute on candidates; report quality-versus-total-budget
cost_contract: C_total includes policy D and A, native tool-side VLM (this actual call1585input/98output), acquisition, rendering, failed branches, checks, load/instance wall time. Zero paid API is not zero GPU or model cost. Training reported separately.

source_overlaps.existing: Observation-thought-action supervision; branch execution with critic-guided improvement. Reason-before-action is not a differentiator.
Progressive visual-state-conditioned reasoning/action and reasoning/action consistency. Consistency reward alone is not a differentiator.
Learning rationales without annotated reasons using answer-likelihood and reference-KL objective. Missing-D learning is not new merely because applied to a scene.

research_decision: Current paired D->A is an identified comparison, not an established main novelty. Do not expand training on one qualified asset. Complete common generation and ordinary baseline first, then require independent whole-room benefit beyond these controls. If ordinary fixes explain it, revise the claim rather than relabel engineering.
